financial_unit: INR crore, except per-share INR and shares crore
scope: Consolidated. Latest balance sheet 2026-09-30. Five forward normalized 12-month scenarios, not management forecasts or calibrated probabilities.

capital.explanation: September shareholding statement gives 142,510,002 issued shares, 997,187 employee-trust shares and 144,763,743 fully diluted shares. Model counts full reported diluted claims at inception with no exercise proceeds. Annual future dilution covers additional future awards. No second recurring SBC cash charge is deducted.

model_conventions.terminal_multiple_basis: Year-five funded operating cash after cash tax, all modeled capex, lease principal and interest, incremental operating working capital, and increase in required liquidity buffer. Treasury income is excluded from terminal operating multiple.
model_conventions.treasury: Only current cash, other bank balances and investments are a starting pool. Exclude all noncurrent financial assets, all current/noncurrent provisions, an unclaimed-dividend proxy, an investment haircut and required operating liquidity. Treasury earns only scenario net yield. Retained cash added once at exit. No liquidation or immediate special dividend is assumed.
model_conventions.operating_working_capital: Net trade receivables + contract assets + other current assets - trade payables - deferred income - other current liabilities - other financial liabilities. Employee provisions are separately reserved. Changes are explicitly funded.
model_conventions.sbc: Cash operating EBIT adds back reported SBC including subtraction of the historical credit. Forecast cash margin is before SBC. Full diluted opening shares and future annual dilution carry its cost. No equity exercise proceeds credited.
model_conventions.leases: Forecast EBITDA includes use-of-right assets through D&A. Add back all D&A, then subtract all cash lease principal and interest. Do not also subtract the opening lease liability.
model_conventions.rd: R&D remains an operating cost in the forecast cash margin. All modeled tangible and intangible capex is deducted. No separately invented AI revenue or capitalized R&D benefit.
model_conventions.funding: Negative funded cash consumes existing available treasury. If treasury becomes negative, an external funding need is explicitly recorded. No automatic borrowing or new equity fills a gap.
model_conventions.returns: Annual dividends plus terminal equity value produce investor IRR. Exit price CAGR is separately labeled. No transaction cost or investor tax included. Terminal multiple and return sensitivities are scenario diagnostics, not a universal hurdle.

downside.rationale: Slow growth, AI-driven pricing pressure and weaker collections. Current working-capital intensity worsens to 32%, margins compress, tax rises, and treasury gets a larger mark-down. Additional INR25cr cash loss is distinct from existing provisions already reserved.

base.rationale: Ten-percent growth lies between current H1 revenue growth of about 8% and Q2 annuity growth of about 15%. Cash EBIT margin is below the TTM ex-SBC level. Working capital and liquidity remain funded, with no assumed return to the old low DSO. Terminal 20x means a 5% funded cash yield, not a rerating to historic peaks.

upside.rationale: SaaS and AI add-ons broaden into company growth, collections improve and customers allow the firm to retain efficiency benefits. This favorable case needs evidence beyond ten bookings and management aspirations.
